summary: Iteration 4 verification. Backend suite expanded 59 → 67 tests, all passing (17-47s depending on parallelism). Added TestEnquiries (5 tests: unauth create OK, 400 validation, admin list, customer 403, admin resolve + 404), TestDefaultAddress (add 2 addresses, first auto-defaults if none pre-existing, star toggle default via POST /api/users/me/addresses/{id}/default, unknown id → 404), TestAuthMeCounters (cart_count/wishlist_count/message_count/unread_notifications all present + int on /api/auth/me). Frontend end-to-end verified on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x780: (Bug1) hero-arrows in bottom-right cluster (x=1640..1728 on desktop, x=286..374 on mobile), hero-dots centered, hero-title / hero-tag / hero-cta-primary fully visible, arrows and dots don't overlap the title bbox on either viewport; prev/next arrow + hero-dot-2 mutate hero-title as expected. (Bug2) Mobile hamburger sheet has role=dialog, largest scrollable child has data-lenis-prevent=true, canScroll=true (scrollHeight 1106 vs client 780, scrolled from 0 → 326); after scroll m-create-company/m-become-retailer/m-enquiry/m-logout all is_visible=true and within viewport. (Bug3) nav-categories absent on desktop navbar (nav-discover/nav-reels/nav-marketplace still present), m-categories still present in mobile Sheet. Enquiry flow: /enquiry renders enquiry-page + enquiry-form; submit with name + requirement (Radix Select) shows enquiry-success screen. Admin login → /admin → admin-tab-enquiries lists rows (5), resolve-enquiry-{id} button fires POST and shows 'Resolved' toast + status pill flips to RESOLVED. Nav badges after adding 1 to cart + 1 to wishlist: nav-cart='1', nav-cart-badge='1', nav-wishlist='1', nav-wishlist-badge='1', nav-unread-badge='3', nav-notifications='3'. Cart summary displays no-refund-note ('All sales are final — Sketch does not offer refunds. Disputes are resolved via support.'). Support/FAQ has an explicit refund FAQ entry ('What is the refund policy?' → 'There is none — all sales are final...'). Login used email/password from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; cookie auth working. Cleaned up 5 TEST_ enquiries + cleared login_attempts before final run.

minor.issue: TestCheckout.test_full_purchase_flow + TestSellerShipping.test_ship_and_deliver can flake if TEST_widget seed stock (3) is exhausted by parallel workers before their turn. Re-run passes. Consider bumping seed stock or serializing checkout tests with @pytest.mark.serial.

5-fail lockout is per (ip,email) but the login_attempts collection is never expired/cleaned — after several test iterations stale docs cause 429 on the very first invalid-login test of a fresh run. Add TTL index on login_attempts.last_attempt or delete on successful login already exists but doesn't purge cross-run.
No rate limiting on the public enquiry endpoint — anyone can POST unlimited. Consider basic IP-based throttle since this endpoint spams the super_admin inbox via notify().
Returns all enquiries with .to_list(200) but no pagination / status filter — will get slow when enquiries pile up.

issues: Left-side gradient overlay still slightly clips the kicker copy on desktop (was reported in iter_3, remains unchanged). Not blocking.
Seeded reels with placeholder media_url='http://x/img.png' still produce ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED + Mixed-Content warnings. Filter or fallback poster suggested.
Budget shows '₹NaN' when budget is a free-text string (e.g. '10L') rather than a number — parseInt/inr() fallback needed.

(LOW) Bump TEST_widget seed stock (currently 3) or mark checkout+shipping tests non-parallel to remove xdist flake.

(LOW / carry-over) Replace reels placeholder media URLs to remove console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1984 lines — the split-into-routers debt keeps growing every iteration. Extract enquiries, addresses, notifications into their own router modules.

POST /users/me/addresses hard-codes required keys `line/city/pin` — but the earlier addresses UI (and iter_3 tests) exercised the same schema. Field names are inconsistent with a checkout `body.get('address')` free-text field in orders. Standardise the address shape (line1/line2/city/state/pincode) app-wide.
PUT /users/me/addresses/{id} does not allow updating `is_default`; a client can only flip default via the new endpoint — fine, but document it (or return the merged doc for consistency).

POST /api/enquiries notifies only super_admin role, but list_enquiries + resolve are guarded by ADMIN_ROLES (admin + super_admin). Regular admins never get notified — either widen the notify recipients or narrow the RBAC to super_admin only.
enquiry doc has no `resolved_by` / `resolved_at` audit fields — add for accountability.
no-refund-note is only rendered inside the checkout aside (only when cart has items) — if user lands on empty cart there is no visible policy. Consider surfacing near cart header too.
auth/me now does 4 extra queries per request (cart, wishlist, notifications count, threads) — this endpoint is polled on every route change; combine into a single aggregate or add short-lived cache.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-4 acceptance criteria verified (hero desktop+mobile, mobile-menu scroll, no desktop nav-categories, enquiry create+admin resolve, cart no-refund-note, nav badges, FAQ refund entry)

test_credentials: All accounts in /app/memory/test_credentials.md verified working. Used customer@sketch.app and admin@sketch.app for UI runs.
seed_data_creation: TestEnquiries creates one TEST_enq-prefixed enquiry per run (cleaned up post-test via direct db call). TestDefaultAddress creates 2 TEST_ addresses on customer and deletes them. UI test also submitted 1 TEST_UI Enq via /enquiry and 5 admin-resolved leftover TEST_ enquiries were purged. login_attempts collection was cleared once before the final suite run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 67 tests. If TestCheckout or TestSellerShipping fails with 'Cart is empty' / 'Order cannot be shipped', it is an xdist stock race — reseed TEST_widget or re-run. If TestAuth.test_login_invalid returns 429 instead of 401, clear the login_attempts collection (`db.login_attempts.delete_many({})`) before running.
